members.name: name
members.doc: File or folder name, with its extension. The extension picks the icon.

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id. Defaults to the path from the root, such as `src/app/page.tsx`.

members.name: children
members.doc: Present on folders (use an empty array for an empty folder); absent on files.

members.name: status
members.doc: Version control state, shown as a letter at the end of the row. A folder shows a dot when anything inside it changed.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Keeps the row visible but skips it for selection and keyboard focus.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Replaces the icon picked from the extension.

types.name: FileTreeProps
types.doc: A file explorer tree. Folders open on a height spring while their rows arrive one after another; files carry an icon for their type. Keyboard: arrows move and open or close, Home and End jump, Enter or Space activates, typing a name jumps to it, and * opens sibling folders.

members.name: nodes
members.doc: The root level of files and folders.

members.name: value
members.doc: Id of the selected file (controlled). Pass null for none.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called when a row is selected.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Called with the next list of open folder ids.

members.name: onOpen
members.doc: Called when a file is opened with Enter or a double click.

members.name: selectFolders
members.doc: Lets folders be selected as well as opened.
